# Intelligent Networks Laboratory (INL)

> The Intelligent Networks Laboratory conducts fundamental and applied research across 6G Open-RAN slicing, kernel-level eBPF security telemetry, software-defined networking (SDN), and quantum optical mesh communications.

## Research Areas
- **6G Open-RAN & Edge Orchestration**: Sub-millisecond AI-driven network slicing for multi-tenant 6G cellular architectures.
- **Kernel-Level Security Telemetry**: Low-overhead packet inspection and thread isolation using Linux eBPF probes.
- **Quantum Mesh Networks**: Entanglement routing protocols and Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) across optical backbone testbeds.
- **SDN Traffic Engineering**: Hardware offloading of traffic routing algorithms using P4 programmable data plane switches.
